Qualifications Experience working as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or in a similar product-focused role. Understanding of Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum. Familiarity with project management tools such as Jira or similar platforms. Ability to manage competing priorities and make informed decisions in a changing environment. jobs.title: Measurement Specialist
jobs.summary: This role ensures measurement setups deliver reliable tracking and accurate analytics for Danish clients. The specialist owns implementations, troubleshooting, quality assurance, and documentation to make marketing data trustworthy and operational for client teams.
jobs.details: O poslodavcu Do you enjoy finding out why a conversion stopped firing, and then fixing it properly? Want to turn tracking data into decisions clients can trust? At s360, you will help Danish clients build measurement setups that make their marketing more reliable and useful. You will be working closely with the Measurement team across Europe to make sure the data our clients use to run their marketing is correct. Measurement Specialist is a dedicated measurement and tracking specialist role, not a software development position. Your focus is 100% on tags, analytics pipelines, and data reliability. Deliver tracking that holds up You will work across quick fixes and larger implementations, making sure setups are technically sound, well documented, and ready for client use. On smaller tasks, you will own the process from start to finish, including client contact. On larger builds, a Denmark-based lead will handle scoping and the client relationship while you own the delivery. Your main responsibilities will be: Troubleshooting: Find and fix tracking issues across Google Ads, GA4, Meta and other ad platforms for Danish clients. Implementation projects: Build and configure GA4 and Google Tag Manager setups, client-side and server-side, including Consent Mode v2, Enhanced Conversions and conversion APIs. dataLayer specifications: Write dataLayer specifications for client developers and validate their implementation before go-live. Ownership: Own small tasks end to end, including direct client contact, and deliver the build on larger projects scoped by a Denmark-based lead. Quality assurance: Test every setup before handover so it passes Quality Assurance checks without rework. Documentation: Document each implementation so a colleague can take it over without a handover meeting. Reference: vbMuDrjHwUCBc73yxs0QrVKZSlCHkc4hUVSdMbgg7BMn-loqBfIyDNCRXVoX9THE Join our international Measurement team You will be joining our growing and international Measurement team, made up of specialists from different countries, all sharing the same passion for making data come alive and turning numbers into real impact. Most of your work will be for Danish clients, together with colleagues in Denmark and Barcelona who know these accounts well. We talk through difficult setups in our weekly team meeting, and you'll always have someone to spar with when a problem doesn't make sense. Your day-to-day base will be our office in central Belgrade, which you'll share with s360 colleagues from other teams. You'll be one of the first Measurement specialists in Belgrade, so you'll have a real say in how we set up the work there. Bring hands-on tracking skills and technical depth We are looking for a colleague who can work independently, communicate clearly, and keep quality high across both quick fixes and longer builds. You are the kind of person who tests before you hand anything over, and you speak up when something in a setup doesn't add up. You'll probably be a good fit if you recognise the following about yourself: Advanced Analytics & Tagging: You have 2+ years of hands-on experience with GTM (client- and server-side via Stape/Google Cloud), GA4 (custom events, e-commerce, debugging), plus enough JavaScript to navigate and customize the dataLayer comfortably.
